nodes.label: RF Nexus preview
nodes.about: A static export of the RF Nexus interface on Cloud Run. No backend: API calls answer 503. Not part of RabbitOS.

nodes.label: Failover Worker
nodes.about: Written and tested; not on the live route yet.

nodes.label: Cloudflare sandbox
nodes.about: The original guest terminal, kept as the fallback.

nodes.label: Owner shell broker
nodes.about: Runs commands for the signed-in owner only.

nodes.label: Visitor shell
nodes.about: Cloud Run: one throwaway terminal per guest, with claude, gemini, copilot and common languages.

nodes.label: Allowlist proxy
nodes.about: The only way out of the visitor shell: 13 named hosts, nothing else.

nodes.label: App mirror
nodes.about: A read copy of the console on Cloud Run (run.rabbitsoftware.io).

nodes.label: Status recorder
nodes.about: Cloud Run job, every 5 minutes: checks the public services and writes the feed.

nodes.label: Weekly audit
nodes.about: Scheduler, Workflow and Cloud Run job: crawls both sites and writes a report with maps.

nodes.label: Cloud backup job
nodes.about: Cloud Run job rabbit-backup: Supabase dump and Cloudflare D1, KV, R2 into the private bucket, nightly. Written and tested; waiting for you to set it up.

nodes.label: Cloud miner
nodes.about: Cloud Run job rabbit-miner: mines the rabbit web snapshot onto the Maxwell chain nightly (05:00), mirrors it to the app first, then publishes the chain. Mined block 3.

nodes.label: Obsidian vault
nodes.about: Notes, agent files and docs on the owner's PC. Linked folders (the whole PC) stay out of every copy.

nodes.label: Vault copy (private)
nodes.about: Private, versioned bucket: the vault set, uploaded hourly. Nothing else can read it.

nodes.label: Bitcoin anchor job
nodes.about: Cloud Run job rabbit-anchor: OpenTimestamps proofs of the ledger and Maxwell chain heads, every 6 hours when they changed.

nodes.label: Ethereum and XRPL anchor job
nodes.about: Cloud Run job rabbit-anchor-chains: posts the anchor fingerprint to Ethereum and the XRP Ledger. Deployed and tested; its schedule is paused until the two fee accounts are funded.

nodes.label: Bitcoin (OpenTimestamps)
nodes.about: Public calendars batch the digests into Bitcoin transactions; the proofs are upgraded when a block confirms.

nodes.label: Wallet key (Cloud KMS HSM)
nodes.about: One secp256k1 key in a hardware module: the Bitcoin and Ethereum donation addresses come from its public half. The private key cannot leave. Donations are open: the front page, /donate and the app show the addresses with open-in-wallet links.

nodes.label: Wallet watcher
nodes.about: Cloud Run job rabbit-wallet-watch every 30 minutes: reads the wallet addresses from public networks, keeps a private record of what arrived, and emails the owner. No signing permission.

nodes.label: Vault mirror job
nodes.about: Cloud Run job rabbit-vault-mirror: clones the vault repository from GitHub every hour into the private vault bucket. Written and tested; waiting for the read-only GitHub token (step 1).

nodes.label: Vault repository (GitHub, private)
nodes.about: therealsickonechase-bit/obsidian-rabbitos-vault: every note, pushed from the PC every 30 minutes. Private; never public.

nodes.label: Vault search (Vertex AI Search)
nodes.about: Search over the private vault copy, re-indexed daily. Owner only, through the owner's own sign-in.

nodes.label: Image Space (Hugging Face)
nodes.about: rabbitos-eeg-qwen-image on ZeroGPU: draws an image from fixed words. Receives words only, never numbers, titles, notes or raw signals.

nodes.label: RabbitSoftware model (Hugging Face)
nodes.about: Llama-3.2-3B-RabbitSoftware-GGUF: LoRA fine-tune of Llama 3.2 3B Instruct in GGUF. Public.

nodes.label: Datasets and buckets (Hugging Face)
nodes.about: Three datasets (two private) and four buckets (RabbitAI is 1.7 GB). Backed up to Google Cloud every night from the owner's PC.

nodes.label: Research Agent (A2A)
nodes.about: Cloud Run rabbit-research-agent: answers the A2A protocol with live read-only searches of PubMed, Europe PMC, ClinicalTrials.gov and openFDA. Stores nothing, no secrets, no roles.

nodes.label: Agent Registry
nodes.about: Google Cloud Agent Registry: lists the Research Agent and the Hub MCP so they can be found and called. Describes, does not grant access.

nodes.label: Anchoring key (Cloud KMS HSM)
nodes.about: A second hardware key, separate from the donation key, that signs the Ethereum and XRP Ledger anchor transactions. It is meant to hold only fee money.

nodes.label: Vertex AI (Gemini)
nodes.about: The Gemini model that assistants on the owner's computer use.

nodes.label: Kubernetes cluster
nodes.about: Not created. A script is ready if it is ever wanted.

nodes.label: Research agents
nodes.about: Python agents that find public research and sync it through a signed ingest.

nodes.label: Daily backup job
nodes.about: Windows scheduled task at 3:00 AM: miner, chain mirror, backups.

nodes.label: Vault agent
nodes.about: Runs approved jobs on the owner's vault. Owner only.

nodes.label: Allowed internet
nodes.about: Package registries, GitHub, the model APIs and the public RabbitOS app.

nodes.label: Database
nodes.about: Supabase Postgres: 29 tables, row-level security on every table; the system of record.

nodes.label: Packages bucket
nodes.about: Public downloads.

nodes.label: R2 buckets (6)
nodes.about: Chain mirror, sync and vault storage.

nodes.label: Public ledger
nodes.about: World-readable copy of the public chain.

nodes.label: Status feed
nodes.about: World-readable status files for the status page.

nodes.label: Private backups
nodes.about: Versioned private backups. Never reachable from the guest shell.

nodes.label: Audit reports
nodes.about: Private: the weekly audit reports.

nodes.label: BigQuery analytics
nodes.about: Service events, refused requests and status checks, kept 90 days.

nodes.label: Maxwell chain
nodes.about: The local chain file and the rabbit web data miner that anchors snapshots on it.

nodes.label: Personal data
nodes.about: EEG, wearables and labs. Stays on the computer; never sent to a cloud.

nodes.label: Logs, metrics, alerts
nodes.about: Cloud Logging, log-based metrics, five alert policies and a dashboard.

nodes.label: Local research store
nodes.about: corpus, topics, summaries and the audit trail as local files; the source for the signed ingest.

nodes.label: Research tables
nodes.about: research_records, research_topics, research_runs and labelled AI summaries. Public records only.

nodes.label: Data hub and Ask
nodes.about: Public read-only datasets (JSON, CSV, NDJSON) and question answering over research titles.

researchFlow.title: Public sources
researchFlow.what: PubMed, Europe PMC, ClinicalTrials.gov, openFDA, NIH RePORTER, ClinVar and St. Jude publish documented APIs. Nothing is scraped.

researchFlow.title: Research agents
researchFlow.what: Agents on the owner's computer search by topic, match trials, articles and variants, and write short labelled AI summaries.
researchFlow.read_with: runs on a schedule or on request

researchFlow.title: Local store and chain
researchFlow.what: Records stay as local files; findings are anchored as hashes on the Maxwell chain. The chain proves what was found and when, not that it is true.

researchFlow.title: Signed ingest to the app
researchFlow.what: Only public records (id, source, title, link), topics, runs and summaries are sent. Personal data (EEG, wearables, labs) never is.

researchFlow.title: Data hub and pages
researchFlow.what: Public read-only datasets, Ask RabbitOS, the research page and the chain explorer.

researchFlow.title: Hub MCP and the shell
researchFlow.what: Claude, Gemini and Copilot in the guest shell, or on a computer, read all of it through the hub and can search the sources live when the stored records are not enough.
